entities.name: Bacterial uL3 (A1T0E2)
observations: The 212-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt A1T0E2, large ribosomal subunit protein uL3 from Psychromonas ingrahamii.
uL3 binds 23S rRNA near its 3′ end and helps nucleate 50S subunit assembly.
Annotated functions include rRNA binding and structural constituent of ribosome; annotated process is translation.
Annotated location is the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit.
